comment: Filings the member rules in members.mjs and senate.mjs cannot resolve. `house`, by DocID: `bioguide` pins a filing to a Member; `exclude` leaves it out of the tables, with the reason. `senate`, by the bioguide Senate Stock Watcher's record carries: the right one, applied only to records whose last name is `last`. Each was checked by hand against the index or the filing's office line and congress-legislators on 2026-11-18.

8218652.exclude: The filer was never a Member of Congress (paper PTR, MN01, 2022)

8219483.exclude: The filer was never a Member of Congress (paper PTR, PR00, 2023)

9110523.why: Paper PTR filed 2017-03-10 under FL11, two months after the filer's FL09 term ended; the index's district is not the seat held

M000357.why: Office 'McConnell, A. Mitchell Jr. (Senator)', filed 2017 to 2020; M000357 is William McConnell, Senate 1890 to 1891

R000120.why: Office 'Reed, John F. (Senator)' (and the paper filings' 'JOHN F REED'), filed 2012 to 2019; R000120 is John Reed, House 1795 to 1801. Jack Reed's formal name is John F. Reed

U000002.why: Office 'Udall, Tom (Senator)', filed 2019; U000002 is Stewart Udall, House 1955 to 1961. The same senator's 2012 paper filing already carries U000039
